newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.561 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.561 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.561 percent, up from the previous issue's 1.481 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on January 23, raised 1,109.75 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.607 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on January 16, raised 831.85 million and was priced at 99.627 percent.
